# Performance and Pixel

> Performance marketing agency serving Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad) and businesses across India. We run Google Ads, Facebook and Instagram (Meta) ads, YouTube and LinkedIn ads, produce AI video ads, do local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation, and build WhatsApp and CRM automation that follows up with every lead.

Contact: WhatsApp +91 81308 29730 · support@performanceandpixel.com · https://performanceandpixel.com/
